children: Canada Bio-Native AI firm's fiscal Q1 revenue grew 21% yr/yr
Gross margin expanded to 59%, up from 48% a year earlier
Company launched ReefIQ platform and secured US$30 mln credit facility commitment
Company expects shift to recurring, platform-based revenue as ReefIQ and LensAI enterprise deployments grow
MindWalk says US$30 mln credit facility will support onboarding of enterprise clients and platform partnerships
REEFIQ LAUNCH - Co said commercial launch of ReefIQ platform drove shift toward recurring, platform-based revenue
SALES AND MARKETING SPEND - Co attributed higher operating expenses and wider net loss to planned investment in sales and marketing for ReefIQ rollout
GROSS MARGIN EXPANSION - Co said gross margin expanded as revenue grew while cost of sales held steady
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the pharmaceuticals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for MindWalk Holdings Corp is $5.00, about 283.1% above its September 11 closing price of $1.31
